verdicts.line: The paths you walked have hardened into stone.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: Player-walked tiles gain a road tier, lowering cost... roads render green (Hope) / red (Fear) / grey (neutral)... A freshly walked trail renders as compacted earth — the ground remembering you — and becomes paver stone after one generation passes.
verdicts.reason: The chunks specify roads age from compacted earth to paver stone after one generation, not directly to stone.
verdicts.correction: The paths you walked have hardened into paver stone.

verdicts.line: The wanderers you met have built walls, or villages, or vanished entirely.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: A settled tribe whose average enters the devout band (|value| ≥ 6) and holds it for a generation stops wandering and settles as what it feels — Hope roots into an open settlement, Fear digs into a walled camp.
verdicts.reason: Directly reflects the settling rule's architectural outcomes and the possibility of burnout-induced vanishing.

verdicts.line: The ground you crossed is paved now, and people walk it in your color.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: Roads now carry a pole and a strength (init ~3). Tribes follow only their own color's roads... roads render green (Hope) / red (Fear) / grey (neutral).
verdicts.reason: Captures the allegiance-bearing road system and the visual consequence of player movement creating colored circulation.

verdicts.line: Settlements stand where there were only grey huddles before.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: A settled tribe whose average enters the devout band (|value| ≥ 6) and holds it for a generation stops wandering and settles as what it feels — Hope roots into an open settlement, Fear digs into a walled camp.
verdicts.reason: Loses the mechanical specificity that settlements form from devout conviction, not just from grey huddles existing.
verdicts.correction: Where conviction crossed the threshold, settlements and walled camps stand.

verdicts.line: Where tribes held conviction long enough, they stopped moving and built.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: A settled tribe whose average enters the devout band (|value| ≥ 6) and holds it for a generation stops wandering and settles as what it feels
verdicts.reason: Directly translates the settling rule's conviction-threshold and time requirement into visible consequence.

verdicts.line: The earth remembers your steps as stone; the fearful have dug in; the hopeful have raised roofs.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: A freshly walked trail renders as compacted earth — the ground remembering you — and becomes paver stone after one generation passes... Hope roots into an open settlement, Fear digs into a walled camp.
verdicts.reason: Weaves road aging, asymmetric settlement architecture, and the 'ground remembering' phrase into one forensic image.

verdicts.line: What was dirt when you slept is pavement now, and the grey who watched you have chosen sides or disappeared.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: A freshly walked trail renders as compacted earth — the ground remembering you — and becomes paver stone after one generation passes... grey wanderers, pale tentatives, saturated devout
verdicts.reason: Combines road aging with the banded NPC display system showing alignment choices emerging from grey.

verdicts.line: The trails are roads, the wanderers are builders, and the world has aged while you rested.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: Era progression — Nomad/Tribal → Village → Victorian, at tunable sleep thresholds (provisional 6 and 14), derived from sleep count at draw time.
verdicts.reason: The register demands no numbers, but 'aged' implies the era system without showing what aging looks like visually.
verdicts.correction: The trails are roads, the wanderers wear coifs and carry staffs, and settlements have grown clocktowers.
